description: OpenClaw Bridge - Voice-to-AI assistant for smart glasses. Speak commands, get instant AI responses displayed on your glasses.

permissions.reason: Required to capture voice commands and convert speech to text for AI processing
Required to show AI responses and status information on smart glasses

settings.label: Show Live Transcription
settings.description: Display real-time transcription on glasses while speaking

settings.label: Response Animation Speed
settings.description: How fast words appear when displaying AI responses

settings.label: Timezone
settings.description: Timezone for the status bar clock

settings.label: Trigger Words
settings.description: Comma-separated words that send your message to AI (e.g., mac,jarvis,send)

settings.label: Clear Words
settings.description: Comma-separated words that clear the current transcript (e.g., clear,stop)

settings.label: Start in Copilot Mode
settings.description: Enable copilot mode by default when app starts. Copilot mode batches ambient speech and uses AI filtering.

settings.label: Copilot Batch Delay
settings.description: Seconds to wait before processing batched speech in copilot mode

settings.label: Show Status Dashboard
settings.description: Display time, battery, weather, and market info when idle

settings.label: Show Battery Level
settings.description: Include glasses battery percentage in the status bar

settings.label: Show Weather
settings.description: Include current temperature in the status bar

settings.label: Show SPY Price
settings.description: Include S&P 500 ETF price in the status bar

settings.label: Dashboard Timeout
settings.description: Seconds before the dashboard auto-hides (0 = never hide)

settings.label: Response Display Timeout
settings.description: Seconds to keep AI response on screen before clearing

settings.label: Default AI Backend
settings.description: Which AI backend to use by default

settings.label: AI Response Style
settings.description: How detailed should AI responses be

settings.label: Custom System Prompt
settings.description: Override the default AI behavior instructions (leave empty to use default)

settings.label: Head Up Activation Delay
settings.description: Seconds to hold head up before starting transcription

settings.label: Enable Agent Commands
settings.description: Allow voice commands to deploy Cursor or Claude agents

settings.label: Default Repository
settings.description: GitHub repository for agent deployments (owner/repo format)

tools.name: ask_ai
tools.description: Send a voice command directly to the AI backend

tools.name: toggle_copilot
tools.description: Toggle copilot mode on or off

tools.name: switch_ai_mode
tools.description: Switch between OpenClaw and Claude Code backends

tools.name: deploy_cursor_agent
tools.description: Deploy a Cursor AI agent to work on code

tools.name: deploy_claude_agent
tools.description: Deploy a Claude AI agent to work on code
